state_model.rule: Committed state defines the evidence contract; immutable GitHub runs/artifacts/receipts establish post-commit facts for the exact PR head; PR body may provide locators but cannot override committed policy.

historical_rejected_candidates.cause: G-02 canonical truth and G-14 exact-head CI binding
G-04 direct-human origin did not fail closed against app-mediated GitHub events
decision freshness TOCTOU: precondition-start time could be reused at later effect authorization after real expiry

historical_rule: All runs, artifacts, SQLite rows, provider receipts and human ACCEPT events consumed by a rejected candidate are provenance only and cannot satisfy a later exact-candidate gate.

series_definition.basis: PROJECT_COMPLETION_MAP.md P4 requires multiple real runs across more than one repository or independent module set; docs/product/P4_REPEATABILITY_POLICY.md freezes this bounded two-objective, six-execution series.

corrective_controls: GitHub provider-backed global one-shot authority refs
stable effect identity independent of caller run_id and local ledger path
local SQLite retained as crash-safe evidence, not sole uniqueness boundary
exact PR-head checkout assertion in foundation CI
exact GitHub Actions workflow and resolved Docker image identity binding
post-request external-intelligence provenance with prompt hash and zero human solution edits
three independently authorized executions required per real objective
provider-verifiable direct-human origin requires performed_via_github_app to be present and null; app-mediated or missing signals fail closed
decision freshness is re-sampled at the effect-authorization boundary after preconditions; caller-supplied or precondition-start clocks cannot authorize an effect
post_commit_evidence_requirements: Foundation CI must assert exact PR head SHA.
GP001 replay must pass on the same exact PR head.
Corrected six-execution pilot series must pass on the same exact PR head using six new fresh direct-human ACCEPT events.
Artifacts must include raw evidence and SQLite ledgers.
Provider decision/effect receipt refs must exist live and match FINAL bindings.
Target PRs must remain OPEN, DRAFT, UNMERGED with reviewed unchanged heads.
PR #61 body may list immutable run/artifact locators only after the runs exist; the verifier must resolve them independently.
Direct-human request and decision verification must reject non-null or missing performed_via_github_app before any freeze or consequential effect.
A decision that expires during any precondition must block before AAP/effect authority reservation, mutation and review-required success reporting.
current_rule: Resolve the exact current PR #61 head/tree and exact-head immutable evidence. Never reuse human ACCEPT events consumed by a rejected candidate. Freshness must hold at effect authorization after preconditions. Never infer current PASS from historical runs, consumed decisions, mutable prose, or a different SHA.
